items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: They only work with Louis Armstrong, Jelly Roll Morton, King Oliver, and all the rest of them.

ctx.x: He didn't even have no drum with him. He was playing Ghetto at that time. Uh-huh. He was taking up banjo in later years. That's when he went with Louis. He plays occasionally at, you know, like all weekends out there in California.

Well, guys like that, they aren't good enough to work. They only work with Louis Armstrong, Jelly Roll Morton, King Oliver, and all the rest of them. And yet today they're not working. Isn't that funny?
